title: Pick a card
text: Everyone gets two picture cards on their phone. Pick the one you want to draw and keep it secret!

title: Draw it
text: Draw your card on your phone with crayons, a paint bucket and an eraser. No letters or numbers!

title: Guess the pictures
text: Each drawing goes up on the TV. Tap the matching button on your phone. The TV reads the choices out loud.

title: Win pies!
text: A right guess wins 2 pies. Artists win a pie for everyone who guessed theirs. Everybody gets an award at the end!
